# SmartSurf

SmartSurf is a water-sports safety and situational-awareness system. It combines
rider location, independent board tracking, configured Watchdogs and available
spot context to help riders notice meaningful changes. Built by Viktor
Kryvotsiuk in Hoi An, Vietnam. Conditions intelligence is powered by Senlay.

## Available products

- SmartSurf app and Android Companion: web account, saved spots, phone location
  reporting, text-based SmartSurf answers, condition Watchdogs and session data.
  Free to start; Android phone tracking is available as an ARM64 APK.
- SmartSurf Tracker: independent cellular GPS hardware for a board or rider,
  available for preorder. USD 299 total; USD 149.50 refundable deposit.
- Rider + Board Duo: two Trackers, USD 598 total; USD 299 refundable deposit.
- School 10-Tracker Pack: USD 2,990 total; USD 1,495 refundable deposit.
- Intelligence Pro: published prices are USD 4.99 for 30 days or USD 39 for 12
  months, without automatic renewal. New Pro checkout is currently paused.
  Features include personal briefings, wind/wave Watchdogs and text answers
  grounded in the rider's available evidence and profile.
- Schools and instructors: rosters, groups and session-gated location sharing
  with rider consent. School setup and billing are arranged by enquiry.

## Purchase and availability

Hardware deposits remain refundable until written notice that production of the
ordered units is beginning. The balance is due before final assembly. A deposit
does not activate hardware. Shipping, taxes, duties and dispatch estimates are
confirmed before collecting the remaining balance. Checkout and terms are the
authoritative purchase record.

Tracking platform access is included with fully paid hardware. Connectivity is
an allocation of up to 10 years, 500 MB data and 250 SMS per Tracker, subject to
usage and local network coverage. Do not describe it as unlimited or guaranteed
offshore coverage.

End-to-end spoken Companion alerts, hands-free Voice Copilot and wake-word
activation are in development. Adaptive monitoring, the wider opt-in helper
network, and Telegram/WhatsApp/Slack/webhook delivery are planned. In-app and
email alerts are available for supported events. Custom boards remain
quote-only; the Intercom is a prototype.

Demonstrations are illustrative. Forecast verification requires fresh usable
observations; learned local patterns need sufficient history. SmartSurf supports
judgement and does not guarantee safety, recovery or rescue.
